top5_diagnostics.root_cause: Unconditional hot-path C runtime calls on every loop iteration: p113_rt_array_pair (Array.get returning a boxed pair) + p111_rt_op (Array.set), plus per-iteration heap Tuple (a, acc) inline alloc/destructure (p111_rt_ctor/p111_rt_take slow-paths) instead of unboxed scalar+array register threading.

Same array-op bottleneck as local-fold: every DP cell makes multiple unconditional C runtime calls to p113_rt_array_pair (1-3x per function) and p111_rt_op (Array.set), plus boxed tuple threading and 16-20.5% stack-spill traffic.

Massive per-constructor inline alloc/destructure code bloat (7 ctor allocs in down/step, 6 in pick) with heavy freelist/tag/RC branching (67-69 jcc per function), 13-17% stack-spill traffic, and no in-place node reuse or unboxed zipper/tuple representation.

Severe code bloat & branch/allocation churn in recursive tree combinators (warp has 16 take + 14 ctor + 6 keep sites -> 2461 insns, 267 jcc, 295 stack-mem ops) plus heavy heap node rebuilds and RC checks on every swap/merge step.

Innermost FP math (nearest.t) is already clean (0 calls, 0.8% stack-mem), so raytrace is only 2.01x C. Remaining gap is trace/nearest argument spilling (328B frame, 118 stack-mem ops in trace) and boxed Hit/Vec3/Sphere allocations (nearest 2 ctor sites, sphere 9 ctor sites).
